backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual R&D expense and revenue are read from raw SEC Companyfacts tags and are known only by their filed date (<= signal date). Current and prior annual R&D values are matched to same-period annual revenue by fiscal year end. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

2_history_check.exp-20260602-007: Companyfacts growth/quality rejected R&D intensity because the selected sidecar had no research/development canonical field. This run uses raw SEC Companyfacts tags, which are new evidence.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-014/exp-20260615-010/exp-20: Kova capital efficiency, gross profitability, and operating leverage were rejected. This run is not another static profitability or margin-spread filter; it tests innovation investment intensity from a raw field unavailable to those trials.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-002: The prior blocker found no PIT analyst breadth/dispersion data. This run leaves analyst soft ranking aside and uses a free raw SEC field with verified cache coverage.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Raw SEC R&D expense is genuinely new versus the selected Companyfacts sidecar used in recent quality/profitability trials. The economic edge is plausible when rising innovation intensity is already confirmed by relative strength, but the Companyfacts family is saturated and R&D can select expensive long-duration names, so success odds remain low.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual R&D/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual R&D intensity acceleration gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
